reviewedInvariants: Selection requires kind,locale,entryId and canonical sourceHash.
Target sourceHash must match canonical source.
All selected prior values are checked before any clone change; one conflict returns original whole entry.
Allowed field-name set excludes IDs,sourceHash,correctIndex and prototype properties.
JSON clone prevents modifying frozen translation banks; answer/reason order and metadata remain unchanged unless the specifically reviewed textual field is selected.
Type-only imports avoid a runtime circular translation dependency.
Compiler derives source directly from canonical lessons/guides/questions and compares exact Japanese field,existing target,before/source hashes and false review flags.
Duplicate field corrections rejected by compiler; source and target banks not rewritten.
Three getter wrappers only revise returned translations; question/answer/session data are not revised.
Pinned before/after historical loader projections reject arbitrary unknown revisions.
Final helper differs after hardening only by combining type imports; runtime guards remain intact.
Final compiler additionally checks proposal sourceHash when supplied, and supports slash/dot/bracket field notation before canonical schema validation.

findings.evidence: Independent numeric after5 fixture raised TypeError at p.after.trim; builder rejects nonstring after, so normal compiled inputs remain valid.
findings.recommendation: Check typeof before/after and Array.isArray fieldPath before string/array operations if fail-closed handling of malformed bundled JSON is desired.
findings.resolution: Runtime now rejects null patches, nonarray paths, nonstring before/after and blank text without throwing; focused fixtures pass.

findings.evidence: Compiler selects locale from proposal but does not explicitly assert membership in approved-scope targetLocales. Current proposals use approved targets.
findings.recommendation: Assert each proposal locale is in the approved12targetLocales and bind scope file hash.
findings.resolution: Compiler binds approved scope hash, asserts SSWlevel1 and12target locales, and rejects a proposal using unsupported locale; independent negative fixture passes.

findings.evidence: --write validates build first, then writes runtime and receipt in sequence. A second-write OSError can leave a new runtime paired with old/missing receipt.
findings.recommendation: Allocate both payloads into temporary files before replacement if allocation-safe publication is required; otherwise document sequential publication and verify final receipt before commit.
findings.resolution: Compiler now stages both payloads before any os.replace. Actual --write second-allocation OSError fixture observes zero replacements. This is allocation-before-replacement, not transactional multi-file atomicity.

finalCompilerScope.scopeOfIndependentCodeReview: Guard/compiler design and targeted wrappers only; this is not independent semantic review of all421fields.
